decisions.title: Board shape
decisions.recommendation: Prefer rectangular dimensions in validated map content; preserve old maps exactly.
decisions.evidence: Two sizes pass rule, view and save fixtures.

decisions.title: Roster identity/order
decisions.recommendation: Use stable IDs with explicit simulation iteration order; deployment cap is content-driven.
decisions.evidence: Different roster counts preserve deterministic outcomes and tie-breaking.

decisions.title: Terminal precedence
decisions.recommendation: Evaluate explicit hard-failure before objective success when both occur in one resolution.
decisions.evidence: Escort/objective loss on the winning hit has one approved result.

decisions.title: Objective/status clock
decisions.recommendation: Name every counter as actor activation, completed activation or explicit objective tick; avoid vague rounds.
decisions.evidence: HUD, save and reducer use the same unit and boundaries.

decisions.title: Presentation ordering
decisions.recommendation: Use deduplicable ordered result batches; state commits independently of playback.

decisions.title: Summon contract
decisions.recommendation: Prototype one owned companion with a cap, stable ID, ordinary occupancy and explicit dismissal.
decisions.evidence: Owner death, blocked spawn and saved lifetime are covered.

decisions.title: Job learning model
decisions.recommendation: Retain lifetime/spent JP distinction; approve node-specific costs only with migration defaults.
decisions.evidence: Current learned skills/unlocks survive without retroactive spend.

decisions.title: Reserve progression
decisions.recommendation: Prototype reserves preserving their builds; decide shared/earned JP after chapter playtests.
decisions.evidence: Benched characters do not force a mandatory catch-up grind.

decisions.title: Respec policy
decisions.recommendation: Favor recoverable experiments with disclosed costs; define refund scope before UI.
decisions.evidence: No unlimited refund/arbitrage or lost prerequisite ownership.

decisions.title: Injury/permadeath
decisions.recommendation: Keep recoverable default; any permanent-loss mode is opt-in and separately save-labeled.
decisions.evidence: No silent rule change for existing companies.

decisions.title: Faction consequences
decisions.recommendation: Use visible, bounded consequences with alternate required-service access.
decisions.evidence: No branch blocks the only training or mandatory equipment path.

decisions.title: Save evolution
decisions.recommendation: Introduce a new game format only for an approved incompatible shape; keep envelope/DB versions separate.
decisions.evidence: Supported fixtures upgrade and rejected imports preserve progress.

decisions.title: Offline activation
decisions.recommendation: Delay incompatible cache activation until the player can checkpoint/export and a migration path exists.
decisions.evidence: Old/new clients and interrupted updates remain recoverable.

decisions.title: Character directions
decisions.recommendation: Prove four directions on one job before choosing an eight-direction production multiplier.
decisions.evidence: Feet, weapons, camera and mirrored asymmetry pass review.

decisions.title: Performance budget
decisions.recommendation: Measure reference devices before promising sprite, memory or frame-time targets.
decisions.evidence: Profiles include scene, browser, cache and device metadata.

decisions.title: Chapter/canon approval
decisions.recommendation: Treat all blueprint names, dialogue and factions as provisional until an authored slice is reviewed.
decisions.evidence: Approved canon/IDs and branch convergence are recorded.

abilities.name: Call Reedfox
abilities.intent: Spawn one owned companion under the shared summon cap.
abilities.counterplay: Block/contest legal spawn cells; no spawn on occupied terrain.

abilities.name: Pack Signal
abilities.intent: Set its preferred target/position for its next ordinary activation.
abilities.counterplay: No immediate extra action; command expires after the chosen activation.

abilities.name: Sheltering Call
abilities.intent: Grant existing-style guard and one clear defensive role.
abilities.counterplay: Guard does not stack with itself and clears at the approved boundary.

abilities.name: Ember Edge
abilities.intent: Prepare a fire rider for the next weapon attempt; consume on attempt.
abilities.counterplay: A miss still consumes the preparation; no permanent free infusion.

abilities.name: Frost Parry
abilities.intent: Guard with one bounded chill retaliation on a surviving adjacent hit.
abilities.counterplay: Ranged pressure and nonrecursive reaction ordering limit retaliation.

abilities.name: Seam Strike
abilities.intent: A committed hybrid strike with partial armor bypass.
abilities.counterplay: Higher cost and melee exposure; bypass amount needs balance review.

abilities.name: Reagent Flask
abilities.intent: Apply a small temporary wet surface using a finite reagent charge.
abilities.counterplay: Do not conjure infinite inventory or bypass required terrain routes.

abilities.name: Dry Salve
abilities.intent: Cleanse burn and the approved wet-surface/status interaction.
abilities.counterplay: Single-target utility; no damage/heal refund loop.

abilities.name: Catalyst Break
abilities.intent: Consume a prepared mixture for one approved surface reaction.
abilities.counterplay: Requires setup; invalid or absent surface consumes nothing.

abilities.name: Borrowed Vigor
abilities.intent: Transfer a bounded amount of caster HP; cannot reduce caster below one.
abilities.counterplay: No critical healing or transfer multiplication; low-health caster cannot fund it.

abilities.name: Last-light Ward
abilities.intent: Prepare one limited recovery after a surviving hit.
abilities.counterplay: Cannot revive through the ward or recursively trigger itself.

abilities.name: Spirit Tether
abilities.intent: Share a bounded fraction of one damage event with the caster.
abilities.counterplay: Explicit order with guard/reactions; transferred damage cannot spawn another tether chain.

abilities.name: Fold Step
abilities.intent: Reposition the caster with destination/LOS restrictions.
abilities.counterplay: Cannot enter blocked/water cells or automatically activate quest objects.

abilities.name: Return Mark
abilities.intent: Save one temporary anchor eligible for a later paid return.
abilities.counterplay: Anchor expires by a named actor-activation clock; occupied return is rejected.

abilities.name: Trail Stitch
abilities.intent: Grant one bounded route/movement benefit for the next legal move.
abilities.counterplay: No repeated free teleports or extra skill actions.

abilities.name: Thorn Screen
abilities.intent: Create temporary defensive cover with an explicit nonblocking pilot footprint.
abilities.counterplay: Does not wall off required exits; fire/expiry interaction must be defined.

abilities.name: Line Oath
abilities.intent: Guard a small formation with ordinary guard semantics.
abilities.counterplay: Spread, flanking and existing guard replacement limit stacking.

abilities.name: Briar Order
abilities.intent: Prepare one bounded zone-defense trigger for its next activation.
abilities.counterplay: Shared cap/reaction limits; no damage on every render or path sample.

abilities.name: Ember Refrain
abilities.intent: Begin a chant that requires later action commitment to sustain.
abilities.counterplay: Interrupt or force relocation; no free attack while automatically sustaining.

abilities.name: Ash Crescendo
abilities.intent: Spend prepared chant state for a shaped fire payoff.
abilities.counterplay: Needs setup; canceled/expired chant cannot be spent.

abilities.name: Quiet Cadence
abilities.intent: Interrupt an eligible sustained action.
abilities.counterplay: Does not become a universal stun against every enemy ability.

abilities.name: Sightline
abilities.intent: Prepare one accurate long-range attempt with disclosed duration.
abilities.counterplay: Does not see or shoot through blockers; preparation is consumable.

abilities.name: Shard Line
abilities.intent: Hit a bounded ordered line with reduced later-target payoff.
abilities.counterplay: Collision, target order and friendly interaction are previewed.

abilities.name: Mirror Pin
abilities.intent: Apply a short movement restriction while leaving ability use available.
abilities.counterplay: Named duration, cleanse rule and boss eligibility; no permanent lock.

abilities.name: Raise Weir
abilities.intent: Temporarily redirect water/cover with a validated footprint.
abilities.counterplay: Reject map-breaking placements and preserve objective reachability.

abilities.name: Channel Cut
abilities.intent: Create a small readable wet route for later combinations.
abilities.counterplay: Finite length/duration; avoid unlimited lightning setup at no cost.

abilities.name: Setstone
abilities.intent: Form one temporary traversable crossing.
abilities.counterplay: Decide occupied-expiry handling before implementation; never delete an occupying unit.

abilities.name: Breach Vow
abilities.intent: Trade a disclosed defense penalty for a temporary offensive commitment.
abilities.counterplay: Penalty survives the action as specified; cannot cancel it for free after attacking.

abilities.name: Debt Strike
abilities.intent: A high-commitment strike that forfeits the caster's protection.
abilities.counterplay: Remove protection in approved order before retaliation; preview the risk.

abilities.name: Renounce
abilities.intent: Remove an eligible guard/pledge effect under explicit targeting rules.
abilities.counterplay: Costs an action; cannot dispel story/objective flags.

abilities.name: Call Wisp
abilities.intent: Summon one celestial helper using the approved shared owner-cap rule.
abilities.counterplay: Changing jobs or summon families cannot bypass the cap.

abilities.name: Meridian
abilities.intent: Apply a bounded readiness adjustment through the helper relationship.
abilities.counterplay: Per-target limits and action cost prevent permanent timeline lock.

abilities.name: Eventide
abilities.intent: Dismiss a helper for a one-time localized effect.
abilities.counterplay: No resource refund loop, duplicate dismissal or repeated effect after load.

abilities.name: Lantern Order
abilities.intent: Give one bounded next-move benefit through company coordination.
abilities.counterplay: No immediate extra skill activation or infinite mutual orders.

abilities.name: Shared Promise
abilities.intent: Spend company momentum on a defensive coordinated choice.
abilities.counterplay: Competes with offensive momentum use; guard does not multiply itself.

abilities.name: Break the Circle
abilities.intent: Convert a prepared company formation into one reviewed coordinated payoff.
abilities.counterplay: Distinct from current concord before approval; no overlapping duplicate rewards.
